World map geometry: Natural Earth 1:110m "land" and "admin 0 – countries" (public domain, naturalearthdata.com),
via https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector (geojson/, downloaded 2026-11-05).
Projected (Miller, lat -57..80) and triangulated by Tools/worldmap/build_map.py into world_map.json.
